title: What is the percentage of patient who has a abnormal level of glutamic oxal
question:
What is the percentage of patient who has a abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase level, yet he or she is diagnosed with SLE?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase refers to GOT > = 60; percentage = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(COUNT(ID WHERE GOT > = 60 AND Diagnosis = 'SLE'), COUNT(ID WHERE GOT > = 60)), 1.0);

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN p.XCL_064 = 'SLE' THEN l.XCL_014 END) * 1.0 /
  COUNT(l.XCL_014)
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
WHERE l.XCL_016 >= 60;
